showMeHint: Opens this part of the app. The tour stays available at the bottom of the screen.
saveError: We could not save your tour progress. You can keep using FlacronCV.

welcome.title: Welcome to FlacronCV
welcome.body: This short tour shows where to build a CV, write a cover letter, and track jobs. You can leave at any time.

usage.title: Your plan and usage
usage.body: CVs, AI credits, and exports follow your current plan. These counts update as you work. Nothing here starts a payment.

cvs.title: My CVs
cvs.body: Every CV you save is listed here. Tap New CV when you are ready: you pick a template, then edit your own content. This tour does not create a CV for you.

coverLetters.title: Cover letters
coverLetters.body: Write a letter for a role and, if you want, improve a draft with AI later. Opening this tab does not spend credits.

jobs.title: Job tracker
jobs.body: Keep companies and stages in one list, from wishlist to offer. A job is added only when you choose to. Open it from the dashboard.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Browse CV layouts here. Some designs are part of a paid plan. This tour does not select one.

career.title: Career tools
career.body: Career tools is an optional add-on for planning your next move. Open it from the dashboard. This tour does not start anything there.

settings.title: Replay anytime
settings.body: Replay App Tour is in Settings and on the Support page. Finish now and it will not start by itself again.
